responsibility: Declares the public Solaris target support interfaces shared across GCC source files. It provides prototypes for the core Solaris backend helpers in sol2.cc, the Solaris C-family pragma registration entry point from sol2-c.cc, and the Solaris C++ mangling-context hook from sol2-cxx.cc, making this header the interface contract that ties the Solaris implementation files into the rest of GCC.
